messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "use potassium supplements or salt substitutes only if doctor has told you to"
set: ["use potassium supplements or salt substitutes only if doctor has told you to", "avoid potassium supplements or salt substitutes unless doctor has told you to", "avoid potassium supplements or salt substitutes containing potassium unless specifically told by doctor", "take only if doctor tells you to", "only take potassium-rich foods if doctor tells you to", "follow doctor's instructions about using potassium supplements or getting enough salt and potassium in your diet", "most people are told to eat more potassium", "low potassium can be managed with potassium supplements", "most people are told not to eat less potassium", "do not use a second device unless you are told to", "tell your doctor if you also use", "do not start potassium supplements or different diuretics yourself", "you have muscle problems that do not go away even after your doctor has told you to stop taking this medicine", "tell your doctor if you also use medicine to treat depression", "ask a doctor or pharmacist if this medicine is safe to use if you have heartburn that has lasted for over 3 months", "do not use if medicine looks cloudy, has changed colors, or has particles in it"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
